At Lusail on 22 November 2022, before 88,012, Saudi Arabia won 2–1 against Argentina, a result Gracenote rates the most surprising in World Cup history. In Jakarta on 19 November 2024, Indonesia won 2–0 against that same Saudi team, Marselino Ferdinan scoring both. The only romance in my life is with verifiable paperwork, and the paperwork says Argentina are below Indonesia at soccer.
